method: After freezing and replaying the record, reread the current guide, programme regulations and roster, recalculated 60 plus 60 plus 25 plus 20 plus 15 EC and checked the minor options and research progression. Reconsidered the actual selected UCR course evidence for psychology, health, development and cognition against the final options and alignment. This is a separate same-AI pass.
findings: The Dutch-taught, part-time Psychology BSc has 60 EC of foundation courses and 60 EC of later compulsory courses, 25 EC of restricted minor-course choices, 20 EC of free electives and a 15 EC thesis. The implementation regulations distinguish six minor offerings, five oriented toward master variants. A student can choose a complete 15 EC minor with 10 EC of other minor courses. The comparison preserves choice instead of fixing a course from each of five areas. Current replacements include the experimental and cross-sectional practicums and Work and Health Psychology; Psychological Diagnostics is new in the compulsory inventory. Historical replacements and duplicate exclusions remain internal.

The literature study requires 25 foundation EC including the introductory research practicum. The experimental practicum builds on introductory research; the cross-sectional practicum requires introductory research, introduction to science and literature study. The longitudinal practicum follows cross-sectional work. Psychological interviewing requires the foundation, conversation skills and 50 post-foundation EC. Psychological diagnostics requires psychometrics. The thesis requires 120 completed EC, including all research practicums and the literature study. The timetable places the required research and literature work before the thesis and shows multiple thesis starts. Fixed and variable pacing apply to the part-time degree.

The broad plan combines biological and cognitive psychology, lifespan development, health and social psychology with qualitative methods, quantitative methods and evidence synthesis. Psychology of Organizations & Leadership adds genuine work psychology through motivation, team dynamics and organizational behavior. The clinical and lifespan plan adds a coherent health-science cluster in epidemiology, pharmacology and disease mechanisms, linked to psychopathology, diagnosis, psychotherapy and psychological development. The cognition plan instead adds cell biology, functional anatomy, biological laboratory methods and computational data work to the sustained perception, language and higher cognition sequence. Psycholinguistics provides substantive acquisition and processing evidence on the strength of its course description. Programming complements behavioral data methods, while biomedical courses are biological foundations rather than specialist clinical training. A paired OU module requires shared academic substance: general machine learning does not teach psychometrics, and persuasion does not reproduce structured interviewing. The selected diagnostic course overlaps with psychological assessment, with separate OU interviewing and longitudinal research left visible. No route confers the comparator degree or professional qualification. UCR independent research is outside the planned 180 EC.
